scope: Small controlled laboratory comparison with source-appropriate mechanics; site engineering deferred pending independently qualified FORCE water-column observations

shared_lab_test_matrix_assumptions.inflow_provenance: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION for prospective tank experiments; NOT FORCE measurement or a site availability claim
shared_lab_test_matrix_assumptions.turbulence: Measured not prescribed as equivalent without grid/ADV evidence
shared_lab_test_matrix_assumptions.measurement_window: Repeated stable runs at each point and fatigue-relevant transients; length and randomization preregister before testing
mandatory_outputs: time-stamped incoming velocity and quality metadata
mean and time-resolved delivered electrical power
parasitic, auxiliary, actuation and conversion losses
shared_lab_test_matrix_assumptions.reference_boundary: Hold common upstream CONTROL VOLUME and test channel geometry; compare net energy per defined period and full occupancy/spacing, not isolated CP from differing area definitions
shared_lab_test_matrix_assumptions.do_not_generalize: Laboratory freshwater setpoints are not the Minas Passage site current distribution; no annual energy, survivability, or fishing-effect projection
shared_lab_test_matrix_assumptions.acceptance_logic: Each gate independently PASS / FAIL / UNKNOWN with primary evidence; UNKNOWN never equals zero or fail. No weighted numeric winner score.
environmental: Mi'kmaq participation and marine user/rights consultation

candidates.name: Bottom-fixed conventional axial rotor
candidates.scale_context: Published RM1 1:40 laboratory axial twin-rotor, not validated field prototype
candidates.observed_benchmark: RM1-OBS-001: Appendix A 16 points per rotor, not a hydrodynamic simulation
candidates.energy_denominator: single rotor disk area, specify two rotors separately; PTO electric losses not available
candidates.control: fixed pitch in tested experiment; no change of pitch asserted
candidates.loads: torsion is available in appendix means; directly measured thrust and blade fatigue histories not available
candidates.PTO: lab motor/controller and torque transducer; prototype electrical PTO unknown
remaining_falsifiers: independent Cp trend prediction within measurement limits
blade-root alternating loads under matched turbulence
structural loads and retrieval costs within limits

candidates.name: Cross-flow H-rotor
candidates.scale_context: Published RM2 1:6 freshwater tow-tank rotor, not full-scale Nova Scotia device
candidates.observed_benchmark: RM2-OBS-001 and RM2-VARIABILITY-001 from processed source measurements
candidates.energy_denominator: projected frontal area D x H, not axial rotor disk or foil swept envelope
candidates.control: laboratory setpoint TSR; actuator/control energy not validated
candidates.loads: mean CD, instantaneous CP/CD spread and between-revolution MEAN spread; no local structural stress spectrum
candidates.PTO: tow tank controls/rotary power; prototype electric PTO unknown
remaining_falsifiers: repeat runs at matched inflow and control load
blade/strut alternating loads while maintaining delivered power

candidates.name: Non-rotating heaving/pitching hydrofoil
candidates.scale_context: A proposed experimental demonstrator; this repository has no independently transcribed net-energy curve
candidates.observed_benchmark: No physical coefficient curve ingested; tidal_screen/foil_balance.py is bookkeeping only
candidates.energy_denominator: foil envelope span x actual heave stroke and device corridor; must also report incident flux control volume
candidates.control: measure both required active pitch drive energy and recovery energy; passive case separately
candidates.loads: measure simultaneous foil force, moment, heave velocity, angular rate; no fatigue cycles recorded
candidates.PTO: specified linear electromagnetic or hydraulic PTO with explicit net efficiencies, not presumed
remaining_falsifiers: positive repeatable net electrical output after actuator and parasitic power
acceptable full corridor footprint under reversal
